title: RegressionSVM Predict
text: Predict responses using support vector machine (SVM) regression model, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Select trained machine learning model} sets SVM regression model; {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Output data type} sets the data type of yfit output Inherit, {Output data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of yfit output for range checking, {Output data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of yfit output for range checking, {Kernel data type} sets the kernel computation data, {Kernel data type Minimum} sets the minimum kernel computation value for range checking and {Kernel data type Maximum} sets the maximum kernel computation value for range checking. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: x
ports.summary: Predictor data row vector | column vector

params.name: Select trained machine learning model
params.values: SVM regression model svmMdl (default) | RegressionSVM object | CompactRegressionSVM object

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data type off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of yfit output Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Output data type Minimum
params.values: Minimum value of yfit output for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type Maximum
params.values: Maximum value of yfit output for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Kernel data type
params.values: Kernel computation data type double (default) | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | int64 | uint64 | uint32 | boolean | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Kernel data type Minimum
params.values: Minimum kernel computation value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Kernel data type Maximum
params.values: Maximum kernel computation value for range checking [] (default) | scalar
